# Friends Tax Point

> Friends Tax Point is a tax and business consultancy in Kerala, India, serving individuals, farmers, freelancers and businesses since 2001. It has 8 branches across Kollam, Thiruvananthapuram and Pathanamthitta districts.

## Key facts
- Name: Friends Tax Point
- Type: Tax & business consultants (accounting service)
- Founded: 2001
- Region served: Kerala, India (Kollam, Thiruvananthapuram, Pathanamthitta)
- Senior Tax Consultant: Liju Nellickal
- Phone: +91 70129 69190, +91 85479 73534
- Email: lijunellickal@gmail.com
- Website: https://friendstaxpoint.com/
- Office hours: open until 5 PM
- Clients served: 500+; client retention 98%; typical response time under 24 hours

## Services
- Income Tax Return (ITR) filing and PAN card services
- GST registration, GST returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B), annual returns and reconciliation
- TDS / TCS returns, Form 16 and 16A
- Digital Signature Certificates (Class 3 DSC)
- E-way bill generation and e-invoicing
- Business registration: proprietorship, partnership, LLP, private limited company
- Partnership deeds, license registration and project reports
- Accounting and bookkeeping
- Tax planning and Income Tax / GST notice handling
- Rubber Board returns and agricultural subsidy management for rubber planters and farmers
- Vehicle and health insurance

## Service pages
- Salaried Professionals: https://friendstaxpoint.com/services/itr-filing-salaried.html — Income tax return filing for salaried employees and pensioners in Kerala. Form 16, AIS and 26AS reconciled, old vs new regime compared, every deduction claimed.
- Business & GST Filers: https://friendstaxpoint.com/services/gst-registration-returns.html — GST registration, GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and annual returns for businesses in Kerala. Input tax credit reconciled, e-way bills, e-invoicing and GST notice replies.
- Farmers & Rubber Planters: https://friendstaxpoint.com/services/rubber-board-agriculture.html — Rubber Board return filing, subsidy documentation and agricultural income tax reporting for planters and farmers in Kerala. Serving Kollam, Pathanamthitta and Thiruvananthapuram.
- Freelancers & Professionals: https://friendstaxpoint.com/services/freelancer-tax-filing.html — Income tax filing for freelancers, consultants, doctors and professionals in Kerala. Section 44ADA presumptive taxation, TDS refunds, advance tax and GST on services.
- Companies & Startups: https://friendstaxpoint.com/services/company-llp-registration.html — Private limited, LLP and OPC registration in Kerala, plus ROC annual filings, bookkeeping, audit support, partnership deeds, licences and project reports.
- Tax Notices & Planning: https://friendstaxpoint.com/services/tax-notice-reply.html — Expert replies to Income Tax and GST notices in Kerala — sections 139(9), 143(1), 143(2), 148, 245, ASMT-10 and DRC-01 — plus year-round tax planning.

## Frequently asked questions
- How long does ITR filing take? Most returns are filed within 24 hours of receiving complete documents.
- Can I file without visiting? Yes — documents can be shared by phone or email.
- Is agricultural income taxable? Generally exempt in India, but it must be reported correctly in the return; Friends Tax Point helps planters do this and claim subsidies.
- Do you help with tax notices? Yes, for both Income Tax and GST notices.
